text:
Priya: noticed an uptick in 'unattributed' quota for a few customers after the TS SDK compact-header opt-in went live. digging in now.
Jorge: which header changed?
Priya: sdk now emits x-route-compact when opt-in=true. proxy canonicalizer doesn't forward unknown headers, so console never sees routing metadata.
Nina: saw same in staging. dashboard code only checks x-route, x-tenant. no awareness of x-route-compact.
Sam: quick mitigation: add a proxy shim that maps x-route-compact -> x-route and attach x-route-mapped: compact. low-risk rollbackable.
Liam: sounds fine. raise CR and schedule canary. infra-bot: CR-7702 created, requires owner and window.
Priya: owner = Sam. propose canary to zone-us-east-1 in 15m, monitor 30m, then ramp.
Jorge: follow-up: SDKs should dual-write both headers for compatibility rather than relying on proxy forever. we should plan a 90-day dual-write window.
Nina: agree. TS/Go to dual-write in next minor; Python to patch too. add header x-route-compat: dual-write so we can detect.
Sam: I'll implement proxy mapping to add x-route-mapped-source: sdk-compact so console can surface it in audit logs. mapping will preserve original payload.
Priya: test checklist: 1) canary 2) verify unattributed count drops 3) ensure affinity caches not broken 4) billing reconciliation.
Jorge: also emit telemetry event route.mapping.happened with fields (source=ts-sdk, mapped=true). can we add that?
Sam: yes, will add an event. infra-bot: schedule applied, window 15m-16:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Proxy config patch v2026.3 queued for canary in us-east-1.
Nina: console PR to accept x-route-compact in parser is queued but slow. we should not block the proxy fix.
Priya: customer comms: short message "We detected metadata mismatch after SDK opt-in and applied a temporary mapping to preserve quota attribution. Please upgrade to SDK >= upcoming-minor for stable behavior." I'll draft and loop in support.
Jorge: post-mortem action items: 1) proxy mapping (Sam) 2) SDK dual-write release (Jorge + Nina) 3) console parser change (Console team) 4) telemetry dashboard to show mapped vs native attribution (Priya) 5) deprecation schedule (90 days)
Sam: rolling out canary now. will report back in 30m.
Priya: thanks all. saving thread for audit. :thumbsup:
